validity_rules.comparison_feasible_limit: This exact native flag does not directly test motor_shortfall_kw or mass_over_screen_kg. Display these as separate limitations; preserve the raw flag for parity.
validity_rules.all_three_prices_positive: electricity price > 0 AND delivered hydrogen price > 0 AND diesel price > 0
validity_rules.refill_costs: Individual electric_refill_ghs and diesel_refill_ghs use the price-entry flag. cost_saving_ghs uses cost_valid. Do not conflate their availability.
validity_rules.zero_distance: Raw per-distance outputs use denominator guards; UI should mark per-distance interpretation unavailable at zero distance.
